female-education.def: The schooling that girls and women receive. More of it is linked to later marriage, fewer children and fewer child deaths.

ravenstein-laws.def: Patterns of migration that E. G. Ravenstein drew from British census data in 1885 and 1889: most moves are short, many happen in steps, long-distance migrants go to large cities, each flow has a counterflow, and within a country women moved more than men.
